atAGlance: Khoai lang chiên is fried sweet potato with a crisp outside and soft orange or yellow center, often eaten as a simple street snack.
whatItIs: Khoai lang chiên is fried sweet potato, usually crisp outside and soft-sweet inside, sometimes with salt, sesame, or a light batter depending on the stall.
howToEnjoy: Eat it hot while the outside is crisp and the center is sweet. Ask for no chili powder if you want a simple sweet-salty snack.
howLocalsOrder: Order khoai lang chiên as a street snack or side. Ask for no chili, less salt, or pack to go before the batch is bagged.
worthKnowing: Vietnamese fried sweet potato can be a roadside snack rather than dessert; the pleasure is the hot contrast of crisp edge and soft center.
goodToKnow: This is snack food, not a saucy dish. Eat it hot when the outside is crisp and the sweet potato center is still soft.
